scope: Complete EV-01..EV-109 through isolated source repairs, bounded candidate-bound runtime/formal evidence, independent review and supported admission. Historical ledgers are preserved; integration and runtime replacement require their separate current fences.

snapshot.reference: Isolated JJ workspace at immutable base 337f9913; current scoped bytes observed directly.

criticality.rationale: Requested admission is blocked by observed provenance and false-positive verification gaps.

stpa.rationale: Observed printed deployment PASS and file-presence admission can assert safe completion without required behavior.

fmea.rationale: S5 O3 Det4 RPN60; severity floor makes F5 for false system admission.

dependency.rationale: Evidence and authority repairs gate all requested EV admissions.

impact.rationale: Correct admission protects the shared fleet-wide control and evidence boundary.

fmea_modes.cause: Noncanonical writers and unobserved fixed-positive checks can be mistaken for runtime and formal evidence.
fmea_modes.effect: False system admission or unsafe downstream release.
fmea_modes.controls: Preserve history, use canonical Sa-plan, immutable candidates, negative controls, independent sovereign review and effect-time fencing.

stpa_analysis.controller: EV admission programme owner and independent sovereign reviewers
stpa_analysis.control_action: Repair and verify candidate capabilities, then record admission only for satisfied obligations

ucas.context: Required runtime or formal checks are omitted before admission.
ucas.constraint: Every EV has explicit acceptance obligations and executed receipts.

ucas.context: Printouts, stale files, fabricated reviewers or quarantined claims grant admission.
ucas.constraint: Validate evidence content, digests, scope, candidate and independent review; no ceiling changes before review.

ucas.context: A candidate or owner changes after observation.
ucas.constraint: Use immutable JJ revisions and current task/workspace/integration/runtime fences at each effect.

ucas.context: Tests or workers outlive resource or ownership bounds.
ucas.constraint: Bound subprocesses, outputs and lease durations; recheck before effects.

decision.summary: Repair and verify the existing EV programme under canonical authority, beginning with the admission evidence substrate.
alternatives: Repair gaps and execute revision-bound checks
assumptions: User authorizes completing and admitting existing EVs; evidence requirements remain in force.
counterevidence: Only synthetic EV999 exists in the legacy evidence table; actual EV evidence must be obtained.
decision.forecast: Negative tests will expose unsupported admission and fixed-positive verification; genuine runtime/formal obligations may require additional scoped work.
decision.falsifier: Any missing, tampered, stale, wrong-candidate or nonpassing evidence is accepted for admission.
acceptance: All existing EV-01..EV-109 have explicit source, runtime and formal obligations
Candidate-bound checks and negative controls execute successfully
Codex and AGY review is recorded for the candidate
Admission records and policy change only after all required gates pass
decision.rollback: Preserve failed receipts and immutable work. Do not rewrite shared journal/cycle history or replace runtime without its own checked fence and recovery path.
decision.budget: Existing realized tools only; no package downloads or paid inference. Two build jobs, two BEAM schedulers per probe, bounded subprocess timeouts; stage-specific execution ceilings recorded with receipts.
decision.reviewer: Independent code review and actual Codex/AGY sovereign review; no model impersonation.
residuals: Same-UID host mutation remains outside cooperative fences.
Historical broken chain remains evidence; it cannot be rewritten into a pass.
A complete source inventory alone does not establish runtime conformance.
decision.supersedes: 20260909-0210-ev-admission-risk-active.json; regression tests added and five actual failures observed.
